lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A high-density field of circular high-luminance pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a more regular grid-like spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form visible grid-like anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the top edge to low luminance (shadow) below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A long, thin, high-luminance linear feature trailing from the dorsal anterior region into the water column, consistent with an external attachment or entanglement.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated spindle-shaped high-luminance objects situated near the pectoral fin insertion and along the ventral-lateral junction.
